records.public_use: official public CDC surveillance; request snapshot and terms must be recorded at acquisition
records.geography: national, HHS region, state and other CDC levels
records.target: ILI percentage / counts and denominator fields; not local ILITOTAL-identical by default
records.covariates: age-stratified ILI fields, total patients, providers and reporting metadata where exposed
records.revision_backfill: weekly preliminary data; late reports and corrections can revise history
records.request_spec: official CDC FluView export/API; acquire metadata and raw response only after Gate approval

records.authority: CMU Delphi Epidata FluView endpoint with CDC provenance
records.public_use: publicly accessible US Government source; Delphi documents API data licensing
records.geography: nat, HHS regions, census divisions, states and other documented regions
records.target: num_ili, num_patients, unweighted ili, weighted wili; differs from local ILITOTAL until frozen
records.covariates: num_providers and age fields; missing values may be null or imputed by version/access
records.revision_backfill: preliminary data; issue/lag parameters expose historical releases and backfills
records.request_spec: regions=nat; epiweeks=<locked interval>; record issue/lag policy and response metadata; no values this phase

records.authority: CDC NHSN Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data
records.granularity: weekly reporting date / MMWR week-ending date
records.target: hospital admissions/hospitalization/occupancy metrics, not outpatient ILI
records.covariates: hospital capacity, age and influenza-confirmed admission fields
records.revision_backfill: coverage mandates changed; corrections/backfills can revise history
records.request_spec: metadata-only Socrata catalog inspection; never substitute HRD target for ILITOTAL without amendment
